findings.source: texture_contacts.go thumbnail loop followed by global mask paint loop
findings.finding: All thumbnails are painted before all labels. Original _sheet paints thumbnail then two labels for each item before proceeding. Whole-page clipping permits a prior label to overlap a later item thumbnail, so these orders differ.
findings.counterexample: Astra032/root report archive A plus U+0325 repeated16, no LF, seven UI64x40 dark images differs207 channels. This reviewer confirms original/current ordering statically; pixel counterexample not independently reproduced here.
findings.minimal_direction: Retain each item thumbnail and physical-label range; shape once, then paint each item thumbnail followed by its labels in source item order.
